construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit PD25-009 (Planned Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Approved, issue date 2025-11-05: "Planned Development Permit to allow the construction of a four-story multifamily residential building including 65 townhome units and below-ground parking, and the removal of 16 trees (four ordinance-size, 12 non-ordinance-size, and 49 replacement trees)" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City file PD25-009 describes a four-story multifamily residential building including 65 townhome units and below-ground parking; SF YIMBY describes a multi-story apartment complex. The file also covers removal of 16 trees (four ordinance-size, 12 non-ordinance-size) with 49 replacement trees. SF YIMBY reports a 55-foot maximum height and an exterior designed to resemble the adjacent Skyline at Tamien Station condominiums.
